name: ultimate-claude-code-web-design-stack
description: Manifest of every component in this stack: source, version, install method, local path, vendored status, required API keys and license. Use this to audit or update the stack.

components.role: knowledge layer (design intelligence: 79 styles, 192 palettes, 74 font pairings, 119 UX guidelines, 17 GSAP presets, 22 stacks)
components.installation_method: npm i -g ui-ux-pro-max-cli && uipro init --ai claude
components.notes: Authoritative UI/UX Pro Max install. Taste ships an older duplicate (67 styles) which is deliberately excluded. Package 'uipro-cli' is stale per upstream README and must not be used.

components.role: companion design skills shipped by the same CLI
components.installation_method: npm i -g ui-ux-pro-max-cli && uipro init --ai claude
components.notes: skills/ui-styling/LICENSE.txt is an upstream per-skill Apache-2.0 license, preserved in place. 'design' collides by name with the built-in Claude Design canvas skill.

components.role: design skill collection (verb skills: website, critique, polish, animate, adapt, optimize, harden, image-to-code, high-end-visual-design, and more)

excluded.ui-ux-pro-max: stale duplicate — 67 styles / 564K vs official 79 styles / 3.6M
excluded.impeccable: umbrella skill overlapping every verb skill; upstream declares it a derivative of Anthropic frontend-design, which is installed directly

components.license_caveat: 6 skills (design-taste-frontend, minimalist-ui, full-output-enforcement, redesign-existing-projects, industrial-brutalist-ui, high-end-visual-design) are vendored by upstream from lexnlin/learn2vibecode.dev, which ships NO license. See NOTICE.md.

components.role: MCP config, design-review agent, design commands, multi-viewport audit script, CI workflow, docs
taste layer — distinctive, non-generic visual direction
components.installation_method: claude plugin marketplace add anthropics/claude-plugins-official && claude plugin install frontend-design@claude-plugins-official
components.vendor_reason: Marketplace-managed plugin. Vendoring would fork it and break 'claude plugin update'.

components.role: feature development workflow with explorer/architect/reviewer agents
automated multi-agent code review
deep vulnerability scanning and verified patch generation
components.vendor_reason: Marketplace-managed plugin with its own agent fleet.
components.notes: This is the official security plugin. A separate hooks-based 'security-guidance' plugin also exists upstream and may be added alongside.

components.role: anti-over-engineering discipline (YAGNI, stdlib-first)
components.installation_method: claude plugin marketplace add DietrichGebert/ponytail && claude plugin install ponytail@ponytail
components.vendor_reason: Plugin with runtime Node lifecycle hooks and a statusline script; must be installed as a plugin to function.

components.role: persistent cross-session memory
components.installation_method: claude plugin marketplace add thedotmack/claude-mem && claude plugin install claude-mem@thedotmack
components.vendor_reason: npm-distributed system with native deps, a Bun-managed worker daemon, SQLite and a Chroma vector DB. Cannot be meaningfully vendored as files.
components.notes: 'npx claude-mem install' can exit 0 while leaving the plugin in a 'failed to load' state (it populates the marketplace dir via npm, omitting .claude-plugin/marketplace.json). The marketplace route above is used instead.

components.role: browser QA — screenshots, interaction, console
components.vendor_reason: MCP server resolved via npx at runtime.

components.role: Lighthouse audits, performance traces, network analysis
components.vendor_reason: MCP server resolved via npx at runtime.

components.role: component registry search and install
components.vendor_reason: MCP server resolved via npx at runtime.

components.role: the design rules, two constitutions (interaction/motion, image/visual content) and 21-stage workflow enforced by this stack
art direction, image sourcing, image generation, Pinterest reference analysis, component discovery, interactive components
components.api_keys_required: none (the skills themselves); the MCP servers they drive have their own — see below

components.role: image sourcing — search and download licensed stock photography from Pexels, Unsplash and Pixabay with WebP conversion
components.vendor_reason: MCP server resolved via npx at runtime.
components.api_keys_note: At least one required for results. All free tiers. Unsplash requires on-site attribution. Server reports configured providers on startup.
components.verified: npx launch confirmed: '[imagebank-mcp] running. Providers configured: NONE (set API keys)'; tools/list returned 3 tools

components.role: AI image generation and editing via Google Gemini — hero, product, editorial, background artwork, illustration
components.vendor_reason: MCP server resolved via npx at runtime.
components.api_keys_note: Free tier at https://aistudio.google.com/apikey. GEMINI_API_KEY accepted as an alias.
components.verified: npx launch confirmed (exits with 'GOOGLE_AI_API_KEY environment variable is required'); tools/list returned 7 tools

alternative_evaluated.reason: Not published to npm (both 'claude-image-gen' and '@guinacio/claude-image-gen' return 404). Requires a Claude Code plugin install or a git clone plus build, then an absolute path to mcp-server/build/bundle.js — which cannot be expressed as a portable project .mcp.json entry. Overlaps 100% with nanobanana-mcp; Phase 4 forbids installing both. Remains available as an optional user-scope plugin: /plugin install guinacio/claude-image-gen

components.role: component discovery — catalogue search across components, themes and templates; UI generation with variants
components.installation_method: declared in .mcp.json as an http server with an x-api-key header expansion; alternatively 'npx @21st-dev/cli@latest init --client claude'
components.npm_package: @21st-dev/cli (v1.16.0 — interactive setup only; the server itself is remote)
components.vendor_reason: Remote HTTP MCP server; nothing to vendor.
components.api_keys_note: Generate at https://21st.dev/mcp. Old 'Magic' console keys were reset upstream and no longer work.
components.verified: endpoint reachable — unauthenticated tools/list returns JSON-RPC -32001 'Not authenticated - your API key is missing or was reset'. Full tool surface NOT verified (requires a key).
components.notes: npm '@21st-dev/magic' (0.2.2) is explicitly a deprecated compatibility proxy upstream and is deliberately NOT used.

components.role: visual reference and art-direction research — inspect boards and pins, search where permissions allow
components.installation_method: declared in .mcp.json as an http server; browser OAuth on first use
components.vendor_reason: Remote HTTP MCP server on Cloudflare Workers.
components.api_keys_note: Hosted route uses browser OAuth — no key in any repo file. Self-hosting requires PINTEREST_CLIENT_ID, PINTEREST_CLIENT_SECRET and COOKIE_ENCRYPTION_KEY as Wrangler secrets.
components.verified: endpoint reachable — unauthenticated tools/list returns HTTP 401 {'error':'invalid_token'}. OAuth flow NOT completed (requires interactive browser consent).
components.notes: Reference only. Write/delete tools (create_pin, update_board, delete_pin) are exposed by the server but must not be called in a design workflow. Pinterest images are never downloaded into a site.

components.role: animated and interaction-led components — text animation, cursor effects, scroll effects, galleries, interactive cards, backgrounds, navigation
components.installation_method: shadcn registry namespace '@react-bits' in the consuming project's components.json; consumed through the shadcn MCP already installed
components.vendor_reason: Components are added as owned source into the consuming project, not into this stack.
components.verified: registry.json fetched — 664 items, 166 unique components; individual items (SplitText-TS-TW, Magnet-TS-TW) return valid shadcn registry-item JSON
components.notes: NO new MCP server added. 'duolabstech/react-bits-mcp-server' was evaluated and rejected: its README claims npm 'react-bits-mcp-server' but that package is not published (404). The shadcn-registry route is used instead — one search path, no unmaintained server, components land as owned source.

components.role: secondary source for premium cards, spotlight effects, hover effects, background effects, animated navigation, interactive hero elements
components.installation_method: optional shadcn registry namespace '@aceternity' in the consuming project's components.json
components.verified: registry.json and registry/spotlight.json fetched — valid shadcn registry JSON
components.used_by: skills/interactive-components (hierarchy level 5 — last resort before custom)
components.notes: NO MCP server added. 'devinoldenburg/aceternity-mcp' does not exist (GitHub returns 404). Aceternity overlaps React Bits heavily; it is level 5 in the selection hierarchy and requires a documented justification, to avoid duplicate components and two animation runtimes.
